_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: PULLED LIVE AT 10:23 ET AND NOT CARRIED FORWARD: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits and ZERO unsettled, so the whole balance is settled and no good-faith violation is reachable - unchanged from the 09:43 read because nothing has traded. Equity and option position lists were BOTH queried live at 10:23 and BOTH ARE EMPTY, so NO EXIT OF ANY KIND IS DUE: no target, no stop, no time stop and no option no-fly window exists to be reached this hour. ZERO equity orders exist with a created_at floor of 2026-08-20, so today's 159.36 TGT specification has NOT been executed or partially executed by anyone and agentTrades stays 0. THE SPECIFICATION IS RE-QUOTED AND CONFIRMED, NOT KILLED: TGT is 158.90 bid / 159.19 ask at 14:24:53.879Z on a 0.182% spread, last 159.04 against the 159.00 settled close, so THE 159.36 LIMIT IS 0.17 ABOVE THE OFFER AND MARKETABLE - it fills now at 159.19 or better, for 318.38 rather than 318.72, which is 31.5% of the account and inside the 40% single-name ceiling. Both written invalidations are untouched: the 154.58 early warning is the opening-bar low and nothing has traded below it since, the lowest subsequent five-minute low being 157.68, and the 152.48 outright void is 6.42 below the bid. THE LIMIT IS NEITHER RAISED NOR LOWERED - a marketable limit invites tidying it down to the offer, which is the same act as raising it performed in the flattering direction. Fired 10:21 against the 10:17 slot, four minutes late and sixteen minutes inside the 20-minute guard. The scope preflight matched the mandate identifier EXACTLY; every other account was discarded unread. The clock was cross-checked against the broker rather than trusted: venue_bid_time reads 14:24:53.879Z against a local 10:24 ET, confirming the -4 EDT offset.

entryWatch.setup: TGT post-earnings DAY-2 continuation off the 8/19 gap-down reversal to a 52-week high - the candidate this board named IN ADVANCE yesterday, specified today at a 159.36 limit for 2 shares
entryWatch.trigger: ARMED, RE-QUOTED AT 10:24 AND CONFIRMED LIVE UNTIL 15:30 ET - AND THE LIMIT IS MARKETABLE RIGHT NOW. TGT is 158.90 bid / 159.19 ask at 14:24:53.879Z, last trade 159.04, a 0.29 spread or 0.182% of mark, against the 159.00 official settled close - 0.06% below the close on the bid and 0.08 ABOVE the 158.82 bid the entry was struck on at 09:47. THE 159.36 LIMIT SITS 0.17 ABOVE THE OFFER, so an order entered now does not rest: it fills immediately at 159.19 or better, 2 shares for 318.38 against the 318.72 it was sized at, 31.5% of the account. In between it ran to a 161.28 session high in the 09:50 bar and faded the whole move back, so the tape is on the level this entry was reasoned on rather than past it. BOTH INVALIDATIONS ARE UNTOUCHED: the early warning is a trade below 154.58, today's opening-bar low, and nothing has traded below it since - the lowest of the nine subsequent five-minute lows is 157.68 - leaving the bid 4.32 or 2.72% clear of it; the outright void is a close below 152.48, 6.42 below the bid and untestable before the bell. THE LIMIT IS NEITHER RAISED NOR LOWERED. An hourly re-reading this at 13:17 needs only the tape and three numbers: 159.36, 154.58 and the 15:30 expiry.
entryWatch.why: CONFIRMED RATHER THAN KILLED, AND THE KILL TEST TURNED ON THE LIMB THIS BOARD ITSELF NOMINATED AS FATAL. A specification dies when its invalidation triggers, when its limit is no longer inside the spread, or when the setup has left the tape. Limbs one and three fail plainly. Limb two is met word-for-word - 159.36 is not inside 158.90/159.19 - and it is met DOWNWARD, which the 8/19 10:21 run wrote was the case worth killing, because the order 'would buy above the offer, into a decline, and the level it was reasoned on is gone'. Each of those three is tested rather than the conclusion inherited, and none holds. The fill is at 159.19, BELOW the limit, so nothing buys above the offer. There is no decline: the bid is 0.06% under the settled close and above the strike bid, and the session's fade came off a high set after the entry. And the level is not gone - it is the level quoted on both sides right now. Yesterday's paragraph describes a tape falling THROUGH a limit and continuing; this is a 0.17 oscillation around the strike on a 0.29-wide spread. THE DOWNWARD KILL FOR THIS ENTRY IS THE WRITTEN 154.58 WARNING, which is what putting the invalidation above the mechanical stop was for, and naming it here means no later run has to re-derive it under time pressure. The limit is also not LOWERED to 159.19 to book a tidier fill - that is raising it in the flattering direction, and confirming a specification is not improving it.

entryWatch.setup: SQM post-earnings day-2 continuation off a 13% beat with a deliberately tepid day-1 reaction - ranked second today and passed over on liquidity
entryWatch.trigger: RE-QUOTED AT 10:24 AND HOLDING ITS DAY-2 GAIN, STILL SECOND ON THE SAME MARGIN IT WAS RANKED SECOND ON. SQM is 76.05 bid / 76.46 ask at 14:24:58.064Z, last 76.23, +0.89% against the 75.38 settled close, showing the same gap-down-and-reclaim shape as TGT. The 0.41 spread is 0.54% of mark against TGT's 0.182% - three times wider - and that liquidity gap, not the thesis, is why it was ranked second at the open and why the ranking is unchanged an hour later.
entryWatch.why: THE HONEST CASE FOR IT IS THAT ITEM 2 PASSES MORE CLEANLY THAN ON THE NAME THAT WAS BOUGHT. SQM beat at 2.31 against 2.04, a 13% beat, and the tape gave it only +1.2% on day 1 - an under-reaction, which means no crowded bulls to unwind and no +8% day to refuse. TGT's day 1 was a 9.7% low-to-close reversal, which is a great deal more to give back. What decides it against SQM is that the same tepid day-1 reaction is also the argument AGAINST a day-2 continuation: a continuation needs day-1 strength to continue, and +1.2% is not much strength. Kept visible so the retro can grade the preference rather than only the name that was written down.

entryWatch.setup: AS post-earnings continuation - the thesis this board specified on 8/18 and again on 8/19, both expired unexecuted, now broken on its own written level
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD ON ITS OWN WRITTEN LEVEL FOR A SECOND SESSION, AND RE-QUOTING IT ONLY CONFIRMS IT. AS is 33.05 bid / 33.08 ask at 14:24:52.416Z, last 33.065, -2.85% against the 34.02 settled close. That is 0.65 BELOW the 33.70 early warning the 8/19 entry wrote in advance as the higher-low the day-2 structure rested on, and 0.82 below the 33.87 limit that expired unexecuted. THE CHEAPER PRICE IS NOT A REPAIRED THESIS. A limit may never be raised to chase a name that got away, and the mirror of that rule, stated at this morning's open, is that a dead level may not be revived because the name came back to it AFTER the structure broke.
entryWatch.why: IT IS NOT RE-STRUCK CHEAPER AND THE REASON IS THE SAME ONE THAT KEEPS SMCI DEAD. The 33.87 limit that expired unexecuted yesterday is now 0.62 ABOVE the offer, so the name this board chased for two sessions is finally available below the price it wanted - and that is exactly when the discipline is worth something. The higher low the whole day-2 thesis rested on has broken, which means a cheaper entry is not a better entry into the same setup, it is an entry into a setup that no longer exists. A limit may never be raised to chase a name that got away; the mirror rule is that a level may not be revived because the name came back to it after the structure broke.

entryWatch.setup: SMCI post-print pullback - the twice-forced thesis this board specified on 8/17 and did not fill, now ABOVE its dead limit for the first time
entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED FOR A NINETEENTH TIME AND STILL NOT REVIVED. SMCI is 37.43 bid / 37.46 ask at 14:24:58.100Z, last 37.44, +2.32% against the 36.58 settled close, on the tightest quote on the board at 0.080% of mark. The ask is 0.78 BELOW the 38.24 limit that expired on 8/17, so the level is marketable again - and it is still refused, because a lower price has never supplied the catalyst item 1 wanted and nineteen tests have not changed that.
entryWatch.why: THE PRICE COMING BACK IS NOT THE CATALYST RETURNING, AND THIS IS THE SESSION TO SAY SO OUT LOUD. That entry was forced on items 1 and 5: no catalyst, with the 8/11 print now seven sessions back, and its own written buy condition unmet. A +3.91% day with nothing dated behind it repairs neither. SMCI appears nowhere in the live 2026-08-19 to 2026-08-26 calendar re-pulled this run. It keeps its place for liquidity alone and is passed over for a name whose item 1 passes on a print one session old.

entryWatch.setup: KLAR post-print collapse - a beat that lost a fifth of the company, now on day 3 with still no base
entryWatch.trigger: RE-QUOTED AT 10:24 AND STILL WAITING ON THE ONE THING IT HAS NEVER HAD. KLAR is 14.19 bid / 14.20 ask at 14:24:50.782Z, last 14.19, -3.66% against the 14.73 settled close - a third consecutive down day, now through the 14.32 level this row carried, grinding lower rather than basing. A base is the precondition any entry here would need and none has formed.
entryWatch.why: IT IS ON THE BOARD AS THE LIVE COUNTEREXAMPLE THAT STOPS ITEM 1 DECAYING INTO A NUMBER CAME OUT, and today it is joined by two much louder ones. AS and KLAR both beat on 8/18; three sessions on, AS is -2.2% and KLAR is -2.7% on top of -22.5%. Neither beat is paying. Meanwhile WMT beat this morning and is -8.6% and AAP beat by 27% and is -20.7%. Four beats, four sell-offs, on one tape - which is the whole argument for reading a catalyst together with positioning rather than counting it on its own.

candidatesNote: Twenty-four names, every row a real timestamped bid rather than a blend. Twelve carried-forward and day-2 names were quoted in one call at 13:42:2x-13:42:3xZ and twelve fresh 8/19-after and 8/20-before reporters in a second call at 13:42:5x-13:43:0xZ. TGT, SQM and AS were RE-QUOTED at 13:47:1xZ when the limit was struck and those numbers are the ones on their rows. The field was widened rather than the bar lowered: every name on the live 8/19-8/20 calendar with a tradeable quote is priced here, including the four beats the tape sold, which are the evidence item 5 passed on.

candidates.note: 158.07 bid at 13:42:28Z and RE-QUOTED 158.82 bid / 159.36 ask at 13:47:11Z, +0.06% against the 159.00 close - THE NAME SPECIFIED TODAY at a 159.36 limit for 2 shares, the third consecutive not-forced entry. Reported 8/19 before the open at 2.46 EPS against 2.25, a 9.3% beat, verified live. Day 1 opened 147.80 BELOW the 152.48 prior close, bottomed 146.21 and closed 159.00 at a 52-week high on 9.47M against a 3.95M thirty-day average. Day 2 repeated the shape in miniature: opened 155.8554, shook out to 154.58, reclaimed to 160.42. Liquidity is the best on the board: 72.2B cap, 672,800 shares in fifteen minutes, 0.339% spread. Its 9/18 options were checked FIRST and refused on spread - 22.2% on the 155 call, 32.2% on the 160, 38.9% on the 165 - which is why the instrument is equity.

75.88 bid at 13:42:26Z and RE-QUOTED 76.53 bid / 76.93 ask at 13:47:11Z, +1.53% on a 2.31 against 2.04 beat. RANKED SECOND. Same gap-down-and-reclaim shape as TGT - opened 74.18 below the 75.38 close, ran 76.27 - and item 2 passes more cleanly, because day 1 paid only +1.2%. Passed over on item 4: 51,087 shares in fifteen minutes against a 896,905 average, 0.52% spread.

33.26 bid at 13:42:30Z and RE-QUOTED 33.25 bid / 33.28 ask at 13:47:10Z, -2.15% against the 34.02 close. THE WRITTEN INVALIDATION HAS TRIGGERED: 33.25 is 0.45 below the 33.70 early-warning level the 8/19 entry named as the higher low the day-2 structure rested on. The dead 33.87 limit is now 0.62 ABOVE the offer and is NOT revived - the structure broke, so a cheaper entry is an entry into a setup that no longer exists.

104.48 bid, -8.59% on an 0.81 against 0.74 BEAT - a 9.5% beat sold off nearly nine percent. The single loudest illustration of item 5 this board has recorded, and the reason item 5 is not a formality on TGT. Not a candidate: buying the down half of a print is not a setup here, and this is day 1 of a collapse rather than a base.
44.55 bid, -20.70% on a 1.03 against 0.81 BEAT - a 27% beat that lost a fifth of the company in one session. Second of today's sold beats and the more extreme. Not a candidate at any price today.

599.98 bid, +3.33% on a 5.10 against 4.72 beat this morning - the best-behaved fresh print on the tape and a genuine day-1 continuation candidate. REFUSED MECHANICALLY BEFORE ANY VIEW IS FORMED: one share is 59.5% of the account against a 40% single-name ceiling, so there is no size at which it can be owned.

316.19 bid, +2.02% on a 3.25 against 3.09 beat after yesterday's close. Effectively day 1. One share is 31.3% of the account so it is affordable, but a 1.72 spread is 0.54% and the beat is 5% - a modest print with a modest reaction is not the day-2 continuation this rulebook buys.

63.83 bid, +24.14% on a 1.46 against 1.13 beat. THE +8% DAY item 2 exists to refuse, by a factor of three. A 1.16 spread is 1.79%, which fails item 4 independently. A day-2 or day-3 entry after this digests is the only shape that could ever qualify.

47.44 bid, -0.57% on an 0.84 against 0.62 beat - a 35% beat that moved the stock essentially nowhere. Third of today's unpaid beats. A print the tape ignored is not a catalyst that can carry a five-session hold.

214.00 bid, -2.73% on a 4.40 against 4.38 beat - two cents, which is not a catalyst, followed by a day-2 fade. TGT's direct comparable and moving the opposite way, which is worth recording next to a TGT entry rather than omitting.

95.02 bid, -3.05% - giving back part of yesterday's +15.81%. The name item 2 refused outright yesterday, now on day 2 and fading, which is the outcome that rule is built to expect rather than a vindication of it.
141.03 bid, -2.40% on a 1.22 against 1.19 BEAT, extending yesterday's -1.4%. A second consecutive down session on a beat - the item-5 mechanism running two days deep.

376.07 bid, +0.75% on a 3.45 against 3.34 beat, recovering yesterday's -0.85%. Refused mechanically regardless: one share is 37.3% of the account, so a single share is nearly the whole 40% ceiling and there is no room to be wrong about size.

321.47 bid, +0.63% after yesterday's -2.53% on a 3.07 against 2.42 beat. One share is 31.9% of the account. Two sessions past the print with the reaction already spent, so item 1 is thinner than TGT's one-session-old catalyst.
162.77 bid, -0.18% after yesterday's +4.91% on a 1.57 against 1.44 beat. Ranked third yesterday and refused on item 2; today it is flat on day 2, which is a stall rather than a continuation.
14.32 bid, -2.72% and a THIRD consecutive down day after an EPS beat of 0.01 against -0.06. Still no base, which is the precondition any entry here would need.

38.01 bid, +3.91%, and now only 0.23 below the 38.24 limit that expired unfilled on 8/17 after nineteen sessions of the refusal being right. Twentieth test, still not revived: seven sessions past the print, absent from the live 8/19-8/26 calendar, and a rising price is not a returning catalyst. Best spread on the board at 0.053%.
124.23 bid, -3.62% on a 1.26 against 1.85 EPS MISS, the largest miss on today's calendar. Priced here so the morning's field is recorded whole rather than only its green half.
121.37 bid, -4.62% on a 1.77 against 2.28 MISS. Not a candidate - a day-1 break on a miss is the opposite end of the setup this rulebook buys.
21.98 bid, -2.22% on an 0.36 against 0.27 beat - a fourth beat the tape sold this morning. A 0.38 spread is 1.70%, which fails item 4 on its own.
90.61 bid, -0.18% on a 1.31 against 1.24 beat. Flat on day 2 after fading yesterday - a print that has stopped mattering.
32.47 bid, -0.03% on an 0.79 against 0.61 beat. A 29% beat with no reaction at all across two sessions, on a 1.08% spread. Recorded rather than bought.
26.97 bid, -1.61% on an 0.64 against 1.08 MISS, extending yesterday's -4.35%. Not a candidate.

93.49 bid, +0.67%, a second bounce session after an 8.66% drop on a 1.06 against 1.35 EPS MISS. A day-2 bounce off a miss is not the day-2 continuation this rulebook buys - the setup requires the print to have been GOOD.
